read.thesis: Q3 2024 incretin supply now ramping (sellable doses up 50%+ in 2H24) while Q3 sales were hit by mid-single-digit channel destock; 2024 revenue guide narrowed to $45.4–46B with top end cut.

utilisation.quote: we remain on-track to exceed the production target of at least 1.5 times the saleable doses of incretin medicines in the second half of this year compared to the second half of last year.

capex.quote: In September, we invested nearly $2 billion to increase our manufacturing footprint in Ireland.

triggers.label: Manufacturing commitments >$20B since 2020
triggers.quote: This brings the total commitments to build, upgrade and acquire manufacturing facilities announced since 2020 to more than $20 billion.

triggers.label: Channel destock hit Q3 sales
triggers.quote: We estimate this inventory decrease impacted Q3 sales of Mounjaro and Zepbound by mid-single digits as a percentage of aggregate used sales of these products.

triggers.label: Revenue guide top end lowered
triggers.quote: This is the driver for lowering the top end of the range.

triggers.label: Rx volume +25% sequential
triggers.quote: U.S. sequential quarter-over-quarter prescription volume growth was 25% in Q3.

guidance.quote: We are updating our revenue guidance range to $45.4 billion to $46 billion.
we remain on-track to exceed the production target of at least 1.5 times the saleable doses of incretin medicines in the second half of this year
EPS is now expected to be in the range of $12.05 to $12.55 on a reported basis
We have updated our estimated effective tax rate to be approximately 17%

red_flags.label: Compounding eroding branded demand
red_flags.quote: thousands of people in the U.S. are getting medicine that is not approved by the FDA for quality, safety or efficacy purposes.

evasions.quote: we will have a chance to lay out that as we did this year in our guidance call in early February.
I don't think we're going to speculate around a hypothetical demand curve
